context: A senpai and a teen chat
purpose: Teach: おかず/歪み/ぶつかる/硬く/防ぎ/意地悪/ほどほど/足取り

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 桜、学食のおかず、種類が多いよね。
lines.en: Sakura — the cafeteria has a lot of side dishes to choose from, doesn't it?
lines.style: Curious, gentle opening. Observing her closely. Soft conversational cadence — he's noticed something about how she moves.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。トレー、運ぶ時、ちょっと歪み気味で、気を付けます。
lines.en: Yeah. When I'm carrying the tray, it warps a bit, so I have to be careful.
lines.style: Matter-of-fact. She's explaining something practical she's already solved. No self-pity — just stating what is. Steady eye contact.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 混雑時、他人とぶつかる時、申し訳ないよな。
lines.en: In the crowded times, when I bump into people… I feel bad about it.
lines.style: Hesitant, more vulnerable than before. Trailing off slightly on the last phrase. He's admitting something that bothers him more than it should.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: 冬、手が硬くなるので、お湯で温めてます。
lines.en: In winter my hands go stiff, so I warm them up with hot water first.
lines.style: Straightforward, practical solution offered without drama. Brief warmth in the delivery — she's found her way through this.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 怪我を防ぎたいから、運動前、ストレッチを。
lines.en: I stretch before exercising because I don't want to get injured.
lines.style: Gentle directional tone, like he's offering this as advice to himself as much as to her. Steady, measured pace. Not lecturing.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: クラスメイトの意地悪な言葉、気にしないようにしてます。
lines.en: When classmates say mean things, I try not to let it get to me.
lines.style: Quiet effort underneath. She's working on this. Not succeeding all the time but trying. Voice thins slightly on the second half.

lines.speaker: ren_uni
lines.jp: 勉強、ほどほどにな、燃え尽きないように。
lines.en: Study, but not too hard — you don't want to burn yourself out.
lines.style: Gentle mentor's wisdom. Soft concern masked as casual advice. He cares about this more than his tone lets on.

lines.speaker: sakura_teen
lines.jp: はい。今日の足取り、いつもより軽いんです。
lines.en: Yeah. My steps feel lighter today than they usually do.
lines.style: Small, genuine brightening. Not performative joy — just a quiet noticing of something good. Slight lift at the end, like a gift she's sharing.
